sloka: तां कथां श्रोतुमिच्छामि विस्तरेण च मैथिलि ।यथानुभूतं कार्त्स्न्येन तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥ २.११८.२५॥
transliteration: tāṁ kathāṁ śrotumicchāmi vistareṇa ca maithili ।yathānubhūtaṁ kārtsnyena tanme tvaṁ vaktumarhasi ॥ 2.118.25॥

translations.english: O daughter of Mithila, I would like to hear the story in detail. You should tell me the whole story as you experienced it.
